title: The /ops Design inspiration screen shows exactly the cards GET /api/templates offers, says why the others are held back, and Unpublish/Publish moves a build off and back
steps: From this checkout: pnpm --filter @tracy/harness-web build (the stand serves packages/web/tracy-harness/dist as /ops, the way the image does).

Export TEST_DATABASE_URL: a Postgres the script may create and drop one scratch schema on (the local compose stand prints it in deploy/.env as TEST_DATABASE_URL; any reachable one works). Nothing else is written there.
Run chrome-watch --status; if no Chrome listens on 127.0.0.1:9222, run chrome-watch. Do not restart or close the borrowed browser.

Run PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=<absolute path of node_modules/.pnpm/playwright@*/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs> TEST_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/ops-design-inspiration-regression node tasks/evidence/ops-design-inspiration/verify.mjs. The script starts its own localhost stand from the real buildApp (real quickstarts routes, real guard, real /ops static serving) on a migrated scratch schema seeded with a fixture shelf, signs in an owner and an editor seat of the tracy_admin workspace with mintSession, and stubs GitHub so nothing leaves the machine.
Read checks.json in EVIDENCE_DIR and look at desktop-light.png and desktop-dark.png.
expect: The script exits 0 and prints verdict PASS checks 19.
The rail lists Design inspiration directly above Quickstarts and still lists Repo catalogue; #ops-topbar-slot is empty on this screen (no environment picker).
The rows of Shown are exactly the template ids of GET /api/templates (5), and the four stat tiles equal the counts computed from that answer (5 / Joomla 4 / WordPress 3 / EmDash 1).
tracy-business is one row with three builds (Joomla, WordPress, EmDash); groups are Bold & Expressive, Professional & Corporate, Starter, in that order.

A warnings badge is on tracy-base, ja-nova and ja-vega only; their tooltips read 'WordPress: No demo on this server to preview', 'The demo on this server runs 1.0.2, not the release’s 1.0.4' and '1 of 1 pictures are not on this server yet: ja-vega-home-1440.png', equal to the API's warnings.
Filters: EmDash 1, WordPress 3, Joomla 4, All 5 rows; category Starter → tracy-base; search 'voy' → ja-voyara.

Not shown lists quickstart/ja-vogue/j6 ('Unpublished from Design inspiration') and quickstart/ja-morgan/wp7 (the draft sentence); No card lists quickstart/ja-kinetic/j6; tracy-airbnb/j6 (design pack) appears on no tab and in neither answer.
On Quickstarts the releases whose On Tracy badge is titled 'On Design inspiration…' are exactly the builds GET /api/templates lists.

Unpublish tracy-business/wp7 from the sheet: tracy-business stays with two builds, /api/templates drops wp7, Not shown gains it with 'Unpublished from Design inspiration'. Publish from the same sheet: three builds again and Not shown is back to two.

Editor seat: the design-systems switch has aria-disabled=true, Refresh from GitHub is disabled, Publish and Unpublish in the sheet are disabled, and DELETE /api/ops/quickstart/inspiration answers 403.
No pageerror, no console error (the browser's own favicon probe is listed separately as ignoredConsole), and no request left the stand (outbound is empty).
evidence: tasks/todo-ops-design-inspiration.md (dev 04/10/2026: the Quickstarts column and /api/templates disagreed on tracy/wp7; tracy-business/j6 released 1.2.0 with its demo on 1.1.0)
fence: One predicate (shownOnInspiration) decides what customers see and what the operations screen and Quickstarts column call shown; warnings never take a card off; the screen reads live server state with no ref picker; only owner/admin seats can change a card. The fixture stand checks the real routes and SPA; the dsh customer-side plugin and real GitHub are outside this case.
